description: Starts an async batch of up to 500 template renders via POST /v1/batch (requires OGMAKE_API_KEY). Returns immediately with a batch_id; poll it with get_batch. Credits are charged per rendered item (cache hits are free) and refunded per failed item. Optional webhookUrl (https) is notified with a signed `batch.completed` event.

font.description: A Google Fonts family name, e.g. Playfair Display.

webhookUrl.description: https URL notified when the batch completes.

name: create_batch
title: Start an async image batch
